concerns.text: SC-002 requires a statistical t-test (p < 0.05) against a null model. Task T024 is marked incomplete ([ ]) and depends on T024a (null model generation), which is also incomplete. There is no completed task ensuring the execution of this statistical validation, leaving SC-002 unimplemented.

SC-001 and US-1 Acceptance Scenario 4 require the pipeline to fail gracefully if <500 valid entries exist. Task T017 (validation for non-zero variance and ≥500 entries) is marked incomplete ([ ]). Without this task, the spec's minimum data requirement cannot be enforced.

The spec defines 'Key Entities' (AlloyRecord, ModelMetrics, SensitivityReport). Tasks T006 and T007 (creating schema contracts for these entities) are marked incomplete ([ ]). This leaves the data model unverified against the spec's structural requirements.

User Story 3 (FR-004, FR-005, SC-003, SC-004) requires permutation importance and sensitivity analysis. All implementation tasks (T028-T033) and test tasks (T026-T027) for US3 are marked incomplete ([ ]). The entire US3 scope is missing executable tasks.
FR-006 requires explicit associational framing. Task T025 (documentation/comment for associational framing) is marked incomplete ([ ]). The constraint is not yet implemented in the code artifacts.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and III (Data Hygiene) require a complete project structure and linting. Tasks T001a (root structure) and T003 (linting config) are marked incomplete ([ ]). The foundational environment is not fully defined.
US-3 Acceptance Scenario 3 requires collinearity checks and stability verification. Tasks T030a and T030b are marked incomplete ([ ]). The stability validation logic is missing.
